research_question: Across preserved pre-draw recommendation artifacts for rounds 1245-1248, how much of each portfolio's missed winning-number performance is attributable to candidate-union exclusion versus failure to co-locate already-covered winning numbers on one line?

historical_scope.contamination_note: Rounds 1244-1249 are previously examined live-history diagnostics; these observations are not clean holdouts or blind performance.

source_data.rule: Use the preserved pre-draw recommendation file and its recorded cutoff t-1; reveal the target outcome only for post-hoc scoring.

metrics.decomposition: For each target, separate winners excluded from the union from winners present in the union but not co-located on the best line. Report whether 2+/3+ was impossible at candidate stage or lost at allocator stage.

comparison_rules: Do not pool or compare artifacts with different ticket counts as if they were matched policies.
Treat the two 1246 artifacts and two 1248 artifacts as separate preserved versions; do not select one retrospectively as the actual purchase.
No p-values, confidence intervals, significance, or predictive-superiority claims from this four-round descriptive sample.
Do not rewrite any original recommendation, error note, freeze, or seal.
No purchase lines are generated or displayed.
promotion_rule: Descriptive failure decomposition only. No signal, model, allocator, or purchase policy promotion; no change to strict gates or prospective confirmation requirements.
